purpose: Make the next bound-parent dot cycle execute integration, verification, critique, replanning and worker-wave preparation instead of emitting another plan-only response.

verified_new_evidence.truth_rule: Re-read exact files before acting; these refs prove the old 16/18 blocker now has recovery evidence available for parent/steward integration, but they do not themselves prove final 18/18 integration or promotion.

execution_steps.detail: List/re-read active queue opportunities, claims, runs, returns, integration receipts and authority heads. Derive actual states rather than trusting queue READY fields or old counters.

Consume both recovery returns as candidate evidence; preserve original A attempts and late-return rule; run final BIGPIC contradiction/coverage/authority audit; produce final convergence successor artifacts and update Architecture/Active Method candidates through correct authority boundaries.
Ingest valid returned canary/meta/verification work not yet integrated. Record consumption separately from immutable worker returns.

Check claim uniqueness, STARTED-before-work, return/DONE lineage, collisions, post-return continuation, scope compliance, context/acceptance receipts and actual useful output. Persist PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL per mechanism.
Persist machine-readable generation/time-bucket metrics from Verification + Critic Control. Never use busy-chat count as the main success metric.

Identify current multiplicative bottleneck, compare at least two plausible routes, check non-regression, check user-intent gaps and decide critic trigger. Ensure fresh critic opportunity if triggered and none valid is active/returned.

Generate dependency-aware opportunities from unresolved stage gates, integrated returns, proposals, incidents, critic findings and existing prepared plans. Prefer implementation/falsification over broad prose.

Compute useful independent worker slots from unclaimed dependency-unblocked compatible work minus active capacity. 8 is a maximum requested wave target, not a mandatory number. Reserve critic independence when required.
Update Continuity Head, FOCUS, Chat Object/frontier and relevant generation/verification receipts before user reply.

If useful slots >0, reply with exact count and one reusable command `PROMETEO → https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/wc`. Otherwise say no human action is needed. Do not dump architecture unless asked.

requirements: no filler work invented solely to occupy chats

success_condition: After the next dot, durable state reflects integrated recovery evidence, verified canary reality, a current bottleneck/route decision, a machine-auditable next frontier and an evidence-derived worker count. The human should be able to launch the recommended number of identical workers without routing or remembering task assignments.
